Indexes: List of BIST indexes shown by KAP for the company.
Sectors: List of KAP sector classifications parsed from the company general-information page.
abcdCode: Additional KAP code field, when present. Kept for traceability.
activityField: Plain-language description of the company's business activity from KAP.
activityStatusText: Plain-language activity status from the general-information page, when available.
bistMarket: BIST market where the company's capital market instrument is traded, such as ANA PAZAR or YILDIZ PAZAR.
capitalCeiling: Registered capital ceiling parsed from KAP, when available.
capitalDetails: Detailed share-class table: share group, bearer/registered status, nominal value, capital ratio, privilege type, and whether the class is traded.
capitalMarketInstrumentCountry: Country of the relevant market or exchange.
capitalMarketInstrumentExchange: Name of the market or exchange, usually BORSA İSTANBUL A.Ş.
capitalMarketInstrumentListingDate: Initial listing/trading date from KAP's market table, when available.
capitalMarketInstrumentMarket: Relevant sub-market from KAP's market table.
capitalMarketInstrumentType: Instrument type in KAP's market table, for example PAY SENEDİ.
cityName: City associated with the KAP member record.
companyCode: Numeric KAP company page code used in company detail URLs.
faaliyetDurumu: KAP activity-status code. Useful for filtering inactive or special-status companies.
financialType: KAP financial type code. Useful when separating ordinary companies, banks, financial firms, funds, or other reporting categories.
freeFloatRatio: Free-float ratio from KAP's Fiili Dolaşımdaki Paylar table.
freeFloatShares: Free-float share amount from KAP's Fiili Dolaşımdaki Paylar table.
freeFloatSymbol: Borsa code from KAP's free-float shares table. Usually the cleanest listed equity ticker.
hasTradedShares: Boolean generated by this script. True when KAP evidence indicates the company has traded shares.
independentAuditCompany: Independent audit company shown on KAP.
kapGeneralUrl: KAP general-information page URL used to build this record.
kapMemberState: KAP member state code. Usually useful for detecting active/inactive member state.
kapMemberTitle: Official company/member title shown on KAP.
kapMemberType: KAP member type code. Useful for distinguishing ordinary issuers from other KAP member categories.
kapSummaryUrl: KAP summary page URL used to build this record.
lastUpdated: ISO timestamp showing when this record was generated.
mkkMemberOid: MKK identifier used by KAP for the listed company/member. Useful for KAP API and download URLs.
numSharesOutstanding: Calculated share count based on nominal share values and per-share nominal value. Used by EPS calculations.
paidInCapital: Paid-in or issued capital parsed from KAP.
payIslemDurumu: KAP share-trading-status flag. Used as one signal that company shares are traded.
relatedMemberOid: KAP/MKK identifier for the related member, usually the independent audit firm.
relatedMemberTitle: Related independent audit firm title shown by KAP, when available.
stockCode: Raw stock/member code shown in KAP memberDetail. May contain multiple codes for some members.
taxNo: Company tax number from KAP registration information.
taxOffice: Company tax office from KAP registration information.
